documents.title: Key revocation
documents.content: Revoke an employee API key immediately when a laptop is lost. Every request checks credential validity.

documents.title: 知识版本
documents.content: 知识文档更新成功后旧版本立即不可检索。构建失败时保留旧版本，首次失败不发布内容。

documents.title: Outbound protection
documents.content: DLP scans document text before sending it to an external embedding provider. Redacted text replaces sensitive values.

documents.title: Index identity
documents.content: An embedding generation fixes model identity, model revision, dimensions and preprocessing. Vectors from different generations must never be mixed.

documents.title: 差旅报销
documents.content: 差旅报销应上传发票和出差审批记录，由财务审核后支付。

documents.title: Audit reliability
documents.content: Security audit records must be durably committed before a successful response is released. Database failure blocks release.

documents.title: 会议室预约
documents.content: 会议室预订需要选择日期、时间和人数。使用完毕应关闭投影仪。

documents.title: Credential handling
documents.content: Provider credentials remain on the server behind a secret reference. Employee configurations contain only the EAP endpoint and employee credential.
